theme: Intermediate operations and practical carriers after urban contraction
question: Which new intermediate contexts distinguish working capability from deposited products and suggest a practical transmission route?
outcome: Eight source records supply 26 observations across hard-stone, ceramic and plant-handling families. Bhagwanpura unfinished objects, Hulas forming/joining traces and directly dated Jognakhera grains improve intermediate candidates. The Harappa mixed bead pot, BPR-208 catalogue conflict, recovery and chronology retain alternative explanations. Twelve broad comparisons exclude no general route; no teacher or diagnostic textual chain is observed.
challenge: Curated or traded working-stage objects, generic operations, mixed phases, plant-bearing clay and absent grain-layer joins can mimic stronger continuity claims.
remedy: Separate field observation, source interpretation and new hypothesis. Credit the existing neighboring-maker learning proposal. Preserve loci, acquisition failures, new paper web-reading scope and raw witnesses. Frame operation signatures and plant-temper tests with imports, contact and convergence controls.
retry_when: New accession verification, sourcing, microstructure, screened waste/tool associations, direct context dates or controlled plant-temper observations discriminate a particular operation and its alternatives. Preserve this endpoint rather than upgrading a deposited object's date to its manufacture.

theme: Whole-hymn learning, work imagery and comparative origins
question: Which components in new early Indian passages distinguish local transmission, inherited repertoires, contact, practical reconstruction and later organization?
outcome: The complete RV 9.112, 10.71 and 10.101 frame contains 27 stanzas, supplemented by nine control summaries and seven lexical-source observations. Work, companionship and collective performance are depicted. RV 10.71.2 directly uses sifting meal to represent shaping speech. The seed-word contact proposal retains an uncertain donor. Iranian/Greek comparisons and DN 1's own-stage normative classification retain distinct evidence and chronology.
challenge: A partial hymn can look like a manual; translation wording can misidentify metal or crop. Shared digital ancestry, repeated book/card numbers and lexical selection can create false joins.
remedy: Freeze full passage and lemma frames, retain ritual context, pair source language and translations, preserve the failed Greek pairing and correct by book. Mark the bīja addition and conceptual-incorporation refinement after reading. Keep literary organization distinct from observed earlier-text redaction.
retry_when: An independently fixed complete passage or parallel-recension set, distinctive inherited image, new donor evidence or matched operation correspondence can test an exposed motivating relation. The selected stanza cannot count again as independent validation.

theme: Comparative inheritance and the limits of automated transmission checks
question: Which inherited controls and inference failures qualify a proposed Harappan contribution to mature literary knowledge?
outcome: Six scoped works in seven target records yield 19 observations; one target is unavailable. Independent Iranian and scholarly comparisons support inherited professional roles while leaving particular local operations open. A separate reconstruction checks all seven coordinator comparisons. A real population observation deliberately mislabeled as teaching passes the validator, demonstrating its semantic limit.
challenge: Comparative reconstruction, population opportunity, represented analogy and field stages can be conflated. Reference completeness cannot judge whether the cited observation supports its label.
remedy: Separate source interpretations, genealogy and chronology; inspect additional material/textual anchors. Narrow the code claim to ID/schema/declaration checks, retain failed wrapper/source-anchor attempts and require manual semantic review. Six explicitly hypothetical countercases delimit stronger implications without assigning historical probabilities.
retry_when: A feature-specific carrier, independent comparative construction or revised source witness can resolve a named transition. Do not turn a schema pass or demographic label into evidence of teaching.

theme: Practical survival, recoding and conceptual incorporation
question: What practical and institutional knowledge could survive the Indus cities and contribute to early Indian literature, and what do rival comparisons now establish?
outcome: Developed four distinct transmission objects: operation, organizing relationship, terminology and explanation. Seven source-based comparisons and 35 rival statements join new intermediate contexts to complete early textual frames. The sifting/speech analogy directly represents conceptual incorporation. Specific local literary descent remains untraced; inherited repertoires and later combinations can coexist with practical local contributions.
challenge: A general continuity theory can conceal missing transitions or imply a single ancestry. The motivating observations and earlier outcomes are already visible, so the new study is exploratory.
remedy: Freeze new candidate/coding frames, preserve old endpoints and raw sources, commission parallel material/textual work and independent criticism, expose the validator's semantic boundary and mark post-reading refinements. A 14-claim map and prospective tests retain exact observations, source dependence and rejection conditions.
retry_when: New dated production/correction sequences, independently validated rare signatures, recipient learning evidence, exact verbal inheritance or a held-out analogy comparison discriminate a named component history. Preserve the present endpoint and use a new dated continuation.
